copy.curiosityHook: With only a phone line linking him to a panicked victim, can a desk-bound dispatcher piece together the truth in time to save her?
copy.description: Demoted to emergency dispatch duty, police officer Asger Holm answers a call from an abducted woman. Confined to his desk, he must rely entirely on the phone line to orchestrate a rescue.
copy.vibeSummary: Fast-paced and emotionally heavy, this claustrophobic suspense drama demands focused attention in an intense solo watch.
copy.whyWatch: Gustav Möller delivers a tight 85-minute Danish thriller that turns an isolated desk into an urgent, high-stakes crime drama driven purely by vocal cues.
